verdict.rationale: Agent discovery of products is a fair question for an ecommerce platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows no cross-merchant catalog or agent-oriented product feed. What it does show is adjacent: a per-store GraphQL Storefront API, an llms.txt file for the developer docs (not merchant products), and AI search on the docs site. None of these is a product feed built for agents or answer engines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my products are discoverable by AI agents and answer engines through a cross-merchant catalog or feed built for agents
